title: Shocked Cat Monday Meme

judge.summary: The square meme has the exact requested captions in large white outlined letters and retains the shocked cat and sofa with both eyes unobstructed.

must_haves.item: The bottom text reads exactly 'BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY', with no full stop.
must_haves.why: The bottom caption matches the requested wording and has no full stop.

must_haves.item: Both text blocks use large white uppercase letters with visible black outlines and fit entirely within the image.
